svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.27.5.5 Fastener Materials
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.27 CLADDING

g.text: Nails for cladding and wood trim, (1)
Nail drawn at 51 mm, the Table

svg.text: Nails or staples for the attachment of
cladding and wood trim are corrosion-resistant
and are compatible with the cladding material.
Drawn: nail heads enlarged. The Article does not name a coating or metal.
